decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposals would be compatible with the appearance of the property, would not harm the living conditions of adjoining neighbours or the viability of adjoining businesses, and would not generate any additional requirement for off-street parking. The development therefore complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.3 (The Use of Upper Floors above Shops and in Town Centres) and T 1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments)
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions and store hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions and store are used.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other openings shall be formed in any elevation of the extensions or store hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used as a store in connection with the existing ground floor shop use of the premises known as 119 Bath Road, Hounslow. The outbuilding shall not be used for living accommodation.
description: Erection of two storey rear extension to existing flat and shop and erection of a detached single storey building for use as a store by existing shop.
